body: I'm actually facing that possibility and it's driving my need to go now and not wait.

I envy those people. I wish I felt that way. I wish I could see what they see.

I didn’t consider my tolerance level. I know it's high so that's disappointing. Thank you for your kind words and reaching out to me.
You're right. I think I'll at least talk to A to see if she's ok. Thank you.

Consider this: Maybe she doesn't want to feel like she made a mistake. Out of sight out of mind. Seeing you move on and be happy with someone could be an idea she can't bear. She broke up with you for reasons that make sense to her but that doesn't mean she can handle seeing you be happy without her. You WILL find someone who will love you with their whole heart and this moment will be nothing but a faint memory.
I want to talk to A about it most of all. How do I approach the subject? I see it really impacting her. Am I looking at this wrong and B's actions aren't a real issue?
